sources.transcript:
# Launch readiness review

Avery (00:01): The launch date stays Friday only if the migration rehearsal finishes by Wednesday and the rollback owner signs off.
Morgan (00:02): Our usual baseline is two failed imports per thousand, but yesterday we saw eighteen failures per thousand after enabling the new parser.
Avery (00:03): We have two real options: keep the parser and add a compatibility gate, or roll it back and delay the customer migration.
Morgan (00:04): The repeatable process is to snapshot the queue, run the rehearsal against the canary tenant, compare error rates, and stop when failures exceed five per thousand.
Avery (00:05): The open question is whether the compatibility gate can be tested before Wednesday without borrowing the incident-response team.
